subject: Interim residency snapshot & cross-region safeguards - MedCare request
messages:
From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@medcare.co>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@medcare.co
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Short-term analytics snapshot across APAC->US - residency questions

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. We run sensitive patient adjacency analytics and need a short-term snapshot export from our APAC tenant into a US analytics region to run a one-off model validation. Can Redwood do a bounded cross-region processing window (we were thinking 24-48 hours) while keeping a firm commitment that primary residency remains in APAC/EU for all persisted data?

Specific asks:
- Will you provide a documented transient-egress playbook (notice window, max duration, destinations)?
- Who are the subprocessors involved for the transient path (any US-based analytics partners)?
- Can we insist on EU-only KMS/HSM for keys (or escrow) during the snapshot?
- Evidence: SOC 2 + subprocessor roster + any audit logs we can review post-window.

I attached our initial DPA Qs (MedCare_DPA_Questions.pdf).

Ava
Ava Collins
Head of Platform Risk, MedCare
ava.collins@medcare.co
+1 415 555 0123

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@medcare.co>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-01T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Short-term analytics snapshot across APAC->US - residency questions

Ava — thanks for the clear list. Summary answer up front: yes, we support bounded cross-region processing windows under strict controls and with documented safeguards; we can accommodate 24 hours by exception with the conditions below. Details: 

1) Transient-egress playbook (what we provide)
- Notice: 48h preferred; we can accept 24h notice if you provide a firm start timestamp.
- Max duration: exceptionable to 24 hours for regulated customers; standard engineering default is 36 hours.
- Destinations: Redwood-managed analytics cluster (US-east) only; no third-party analytics processors unless explicitly authorized in writing.
- Rollback: automatic purge of ephemeral copies + KV cache invalidation; we provide deletion confirmation and a signed audit log snippet.

2) Subprocessors
- For transient path we rely on Redwood-owned compute in the US (no external analytics vendor by default). Persistent storage remains in APAC/EU unless you opt into cross-region persist (we will not persist by default).

3) Keys and encryption
- We can require EU-hosted KMS/HSM for the master key wrapping the transient key material. We support a model where the transient key is generated per-window and wrapped by an EU HSM. We can also support escrow to an EU-based HSM partner for the duration.

4) Evidence
- We can share an excerpted SOC 2 report and a redacted subprocessor roster (attached by Marissa). We will also provide an audit log export (time-limited) after the window completes.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa will share the SOC2 + roster and a checklist.
- You confirm notice window you require (24h vs 48h) and whether you need escrowed HSM or just EU KMS keys.
- Legal can send a short addendum to the DPA; we can sign a 1-2 page transient-egress addendum.

I copied Marissa (ops) and Kimberly (security) to help with evidence and the HSM options.

— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

From: Samir Patel <samir@medbridge.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ava Collins <ava.collins@medcare.co>
Cc: legal@medcare.co
Date: 2027-08-02T08:05:00Z
Subject: Clarifying KMS/HSM footprint + audit granularity

Vanessa — thanks. A couple legal/tech clarifications from MedCare: 
- When you say "EU-hosted KMS/HSM for the master key" can you confirm whether Redwood's control plane ever has access to unwrapped plaintext key material for the transient keys? We need a statement that master key never leaves customer-controlled HSM (or an escrow model we can sign off).
- For the audit logs you mentioned: what fields are included? We need at minimum: initiating principal, source IP block, object identifiers exported, start/end timestamps, and a signed hash for tamper-evidence.

Also, MedCare legal would prefer a maximum of 24 hours for the window due to contractual constraints. If Redwood can accept 24 hours with the HSM escrow + the audit guarantees above, we'll prepare a DPA addendum draft and route for signature.

Samir
Samir Patel
General Counsel, MedBridge (legal advisor to MedCare)

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@medbridge.io>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ava Collins <ava.collins@medcare.co>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-02T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Clarifying KMS/HSM footprint + audit granularity

Samir / Ava — attaching the redacted artifacts: subprocessors_roster.csv and SOC2_report_redacted.pdf. Quick answers inline: 

- Master key handling: Redwood supports two modes: 1) Customer-managed master key in EU KMS (recommended) where Redwood never has plaintext access, or 2) Redwood-managed key with an EU HSM wrapper and short-lived transient keys; in this case we can implement an escrow arrangement to an EU HSM provider for the window. We can provide a control statement and HSM config sheet for legal review.

- Audit logs: our export includes initiating principal (email), request UUIDs, source CIDR, object IDs (redacted to customer namespace), start/end timestamps, and a signed HMAC hash for tamper evidence. We can provide the logs in CSV + GPG-signed hash.

Operational notes:
- Default purge: ephemeral copies are deleted on window close; we provide deletion confirmation with the audit export.
- No third-party analytics vendors will be used unless you explicitly list them in the addendum.

Attachments: subprocessors_roster.csv; SOC2_report_redacted.pdf

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@medbridge.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ava Collins <ava.collins@medcare.co>
Date: 2027-08-03T07:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Clarifying KMS/HSM footprint + audit granularity

Thanks Marissa — the artifacts look good at a glance. One ask from our side: due to international regulatory constraints we'd like the window limited to 24 hours. We'll circulate a DPA addendum (short) that specifies: 24h max, EU-key escrow for wrap, list of allowed destination CIDR, and required audit fields. I've attached a draft (DPA_addendum_draft.docx).

If Redwood can sign off on those specific callouts, we'll route for signature via DocuSign.

Samir

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@medbridge.io>, Ava Collins <ava.collins@medcare.co>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-03T15:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Clarifying KMS/HSM footprint + audit granularity

Samir / Ava — we can accept the 24h bound with the following conditions (so you have the operational commitments to put in the addendum):

1) Notice: 24h prior written notice with start timestamp (we can accept same-day 24h windows if notice is delivered per the addendum).
2) Key model: EU HSM wrap of the per-window transient key + optional escrow to an EU HSM partner (we'll add the HSM provider SST and config sheet in the DocuSign package).
3) Destination: Redwood-managed US-east analytics cluster only; destination CIDR will be listed in the addendum; no external vendors.
4) Audit: we will deliver a CSV export with initiating principal, request UUID, source CIDR, object IDs (customer namespace), start/end timestamps, and a GPG-signed hash within 24h of window close.
5) Deletion: ephemeral copies and caches will be purged within 2 hours of window close; we'll provide signed deletion confirmation.

Operational next steps:
- Legal: sign the DPA addendum via DocuSign (we'll populate the HSM provider and CIDR).
- Ops: schedule maintenance slot and confirm start timestamp.
- Security: Kimberly will run a short pre-window checklist and confirm network ACLs.

I'll send the DocuSign package once you confirm the HSM option (escrow required?) and the exact start time you'd like.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out quickly.

— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
